name: HeroUI
summary: Accessible React UI on React Aria and Tailwind CSS v4 (formerly NextUI).
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 70+ React components listed in docs/sitemap.
Default branch v3 LICENSE is Apache-2.0; some package.json files still list MIT — catalog uses LICENSE file + docs FAQ (Apache-2.0).
Native (React Native) path is a separate product — this ingest is React web only.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Clickable button with variants and states.

demo.peerNotes: npm i @heroui/styles @heroui/react; import @heroui/styles after tailwindcss in CSS. React 19 + Tailwind v4.

components.copyCode:
npm i @heroui/styles @heroui/react
# CSS: @import "tailwindcss"; @import "@heroui/styles";

import { Button } from "@heroui/react"

<Button />

copyPrompt.text: Use HeroUI free Apache-2.0 React component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://heroui.com/docs/react/components/button. Install with `npm i @heroui/styles @heroui/react` (or pnpm/yarn/bun), add `@import "@heroui/styles"` after `@import "tailwindcss"` in globals.css, then `import { Button } from "@heroui/react"`. Quick start: https://heroui.com/docs/react/getting-started/quick-start. Home: https://heroui.com. Repo: https://github.com/heroui-inc/heroui. License: Apache License 2.0 (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heroui-inc/heroui/v3/LICENSE; docs FAQ confirms Apache-2.0). Pricing free. Previously NextUI.
